verdict_reason: The new spec covers choosing a type, its errors, Back and kept entries, but one helper's name hides the actions it performs and sign-in set-up is copied instead of using signInAndOpen.

todos.issue: expectRefusedEntryKeptOnReturn (202-212) reads as an assertion, but it signs in, opens the add form, fills it with a malformed email, saves, follows Back and chooses the type again before asserting. The name hides the sign-in and the whole drive, and the three tests that call it (216-228, 232-240) are one-line bodies with no visible arrange or act.
todos.fix: Must: each test shows its arrange, act and assert, and every helper's name says what it does to the page. One way: inline signIn and refuseSaveThenReopenAddForm into the test bodies and keep only expectEnteredAddressKept as the assertion helper; or rename to say it drives the page, e.g. refuseSaveReopenAndExpectEntryKept.

todos.issue: signIn followed by page.goto is written out at 84-85, 145-146 and 162-164 although the shared helper signInAndOpen(page, organisationId, path) in sign-in-and-open.js does exactly that, and address-form.js already uses it for the same type page.
todos.fix: Must: this spec reaches a page after sign-in through the shared signInAndOpen helper, with no local sign-in-then-goto copies. One way: signInAndOpen(page, 'stub-org-type-error', addressTypePath()) at 84, the same at 145, and signInAndOpen(page, 'stub-org-type-guard', addressAddPath()) at 162.
